ex.en: When it comes to household chores, jobs like cleaning, washing clothes or looking after the kids, it's often women who do most of the work.
ex.zh: 說到家務——像是打掃、洗衣服或照顧小孩這些工作——通常都是女性做了大部分。

tips.t: household chores 家務；do the chores 做家事。職場上也可指例行雜事：Filing is a chore. 歸檔是件苦差事。

pos.m: 應有的一份；應分擔的部分

ex.en: Do you do your fair share of household chores?
ex.zh: 你有分擔你應做的那份家事嗎？

tips.t: do one's fair share 做好自己的本分；pay one's fair share 支付應付的份額。more than one's fair share 超過應有的份量（例：has had more than his fair share of problems 遇到的問題多得不公平）。

ex.en: But with few washing machines and no running water, these domestic chores take a long time.
ex.zh: 但因為洗衣機很少、又沒有自來水，這些家務要花很長的時間。

tips.t: 多益更常考「國內的」：domestic flights 國內航班、domestic market 國內市場（↔ international / overseas）。

pos.m: 無償的，無薪的；未付款的

ex.en: Figures from UN Women, an organisation promoting gender equality, suggest that every day women around the world spend three hours more than men on unpaid care and domestic work.
ex.zh: 推動性別平等的組織「聯合國婦女署」的數據顯示，全世界的女性每天花在無償照護與家務上的時間比男性多三個小時。

tips.t: unpaid leave 無薪假；an unpaid invoice / bill 未付的發票／帳單（帳款催繳信常見）。

ex.en: Many cultures have a division of labour – a way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people.
ex.zh: 許多文化都有分工——一種讓不同群體的人做不同工作的組織方式。

tips.t: labour 是英式拼法，美式是 labor（多益以美式為主）。division 在職場也是「部門」：the sales division 業務部。

ex.en: Women tend to especially appreciate men who do these kinds of chores.
ex.zh: 女性通常特別感激會做這類家事的男性。

tips.t: 書信必考：We appreciate your patience. 感謝您的耐心；I would appreciate it if you could… 如果您能～我將很感激。注意 appreciate 後面直接接事物，不接人（不說 appreciate you for）。

ex.en: Sometimes mums need to take a breather – an informal way of saying stop and rest a while.
ex.zh: 有時候媽媽需要「take a breather」——這是「停下來休息一會兒」的非正式說法。

tips.t: 同義說法：take a break、take a rest。會議中常聽到 Let's take a short breather. 我們稍微休息一下。

pos.m: 盡自己的本分，做好分內工作

ex.en: If you pull your weight, you work as hard as everyone else.
ex.zh: 如果你「pull your weight」，就是你和其他人一樣努力。

tips.t: 團隊合作情境常用：Everyone on the team needs to pull their weight. 團隊每個人都要做好分內工作。
